messages:
Maya (CS): Morning team — Pegasus private VPC cutover day 2. Customer reports sporadic 504s to internal S3 endpoint and higher-than-expected tail latency. They said this could influence renewal talks. Opening CS-8140.

Rowan I: Quick check of our NAT gateway metrics: spikes line up with their backup window 02:10-02:40 UTC. I'm seeing increased retransmits at the same times. Could be KMS rotation + backup job overlap causing decryption stalls.

Eleni K: On KMS: they use daily rotation at 02:15. Backups read objects immediately after rotation — that can cause cache misses and KMS API bursts. Recommend either: (a) delay rotation to 03:00, (b) implement staggered rotation for backup role, or (c) enable local decrypt caching for backup process. We need customer preference.

Pegasus NetOps: Confirmed on our side — their on-prem VPN MTU is 1500 but path PMTU detected 1400. We hit fragmentation at ~1460 bytes. We'll try MSS clamp (1400) for the tunnel and report back.

Maya (CS): Actions: 1) @Rowan gather natgw+elb graphs and attach to CS-8140; 2) @Eleni propose KMS rotation options and a short FAQ entry; 3) @Pegasus NetOps share MSS clamp outcome. Also capture renewal_risk note if variance >5%.

Rowan I: Uploaded graphs and Correlated timestamps to ticket CS-8140. Retransmit rate peaks at 02:12. Added a note asking customer to confirm backup start time and any retries configured.

Eleni K: Draft KMS FAQ blurb added to ticket: "If backups run during a key rotation window, expect transient decrypt latency. Options: shift rotation, exclude backup role during rotation, or use rotate-with-warm-cache pattern." Will add exact IAM snippet for cross-account logging after we confirm account IDs.

Pegasus NetOps: MSS clamp applied on their edge, monitoring now. Early telemetry shows fewer retransmits. Keep an eye on 02:10 window tomorrow.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-8140 updated  assignees: Rowan I, Eleni K, Pegasus NetOps. Status: monitoring. Next automated reminder in 12h.

Maya (CS): Customer feedback captured: they want a one-page "pre-cutover network and KMS checklist" and an explicit note in the onboarding docs about rotating keys co-ordinated with backups. I'll add renewal_risk flag and loop in AM if variance persists after next window. Please keep short updates in the ticket rather than long Slack threads.

Rowan I: Noted. Will post follow-ups in CS-8140.

Eleni K: I'll prepare the FAQ + IAM snippet and PR to onboarding docs. ETA: EOD.

Maya (CS): Thanks all.
